changes: Props take the light of their room (sky through the windows, ambient, lamps, a contact shadow): on in new projects, set in Game > Vertex colours or per prop.
Collision for props that have none (boxes, or a mesh as the last resort): on in new projects, set in Game > Prop collision or per model.
Fixed: game props, game doors and custom doors had no collision in game (re-export your interior).
Fixed: floor and ceiling dirt made hard bands beside windows and doors; it now fades out smoothly before them.
Fixed: a clean slit in the dirt, and a crack in the editor's walls, where two walls meet almost in line.
Fixed: window and door frames, glass and sill boards were missing from outside the interior.
Fixed: louvre window slats stuck out of their frame at an angle.
Fixed: game props and doors that didn't load in game: each is now exported as a copy under the resource's name, with its own texture dictionary.
Props and doors from the game are kept in the project's Assets/Game folder, so a project moved to another computer still finds them.
GTA V Enhanced: export for Legacy, Enhanced or both in one resource (Export > Game).
Linux (beta): Modlo Creator runs on Linux as an AppImage and finds GTA V in Steam (Proton), Lutris, Heroic, Bottles or Wine.
Walk-in buildings: a preview of the building before you pick it, and the models it comes with (decals, glass, props) included, left out or removed from the map.
Walk-in buildings: occluders and the game's floor inside your rooms are cleared on export, so nothing hides or shows through your interior.
Walk-in buildings: Make openings for several marks at once, Keep marks upright, and doors and windows that snap to the building's openings.
Explode points: a new shell tool that casts rays inside a building and builds square walls, doors and windows from the corners you click.
Mirror modifier: build one half and mirror it across X and/or Y.
Wall heights follow the ceiling; cornices follow sloped walls; doors and windows go as high as their own wall.
New handles for floor cuts, zones, railings, ladders, stairs, lights, spawn points, decals, mesh scale and sills.
Number fields work like Blender's, UI scale presets for 1080p to 5K, and Show the keys pressed for recording tutorials.
Experimental: hanging cloth the game simulates, and breakable window glass.
Fixed: custom doors had no collision and never swung in game (re-export older projects).
Fixed: a walk-in doorway cut a hole into the ground in front of the door.
Fixed: a mirror didn't show the door of its room (not yet checked in game), Array... showed twice with several props selected, dirt along the floor vanished under windows.
First release.
